settings.pageDescription: Manage the look and language of the platform, and choose the model services that organize your knowledge. Changes take effect right away.
settings.sectionNavigationNote: Check the engine status, then adjust appearance or model services.
settings.inferenceDescription: Choose the services used for conversation and knowledge search. Changes take effect right away.
settings.llmDescription: Choose the service the knowledge engine uses to organize and search your knowledge. Changes take effect right away.
settings.notConfigured: not set up — engine is paused
settings.apiKeyKeepHint: Leave it blank to keep the current key.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language used throughout the platform, including messages and newly organized knowledge.
settings.themeDescription: Choose Light, Dark, or follow your system preference. This setting is shared across your browsers.

engineHealth.learningEngineDescription: See how knowledge processing is doing, including items waiting, in progress, or needing attention.
engineHealth.hygieneDescription: Older, less-used knowledge is moved for review, then archived if it remains untouched. Runs automatically, or start it now.
engineHealth.statusDegradedDetail: We couldn't reach the knowledge engine.
engineHealth.emptyState: Nothing has been processed yet. When your agents share activity, organized knowledge will appear here.
engineHealth.actionResult: Maintenance complete: {{decayed}} moved for review, {{movedToReview}} sent to review, {{archived}} archived.
